head: 37ff0b4d
summary: R02 owner journey is now implemented and verified in the real apphost. One click on an icon-only Spaces rail entry opens a conversation scoped to that Space directly (no details/sources interstitial); the conversation is mounted in the authored space-app-content region so the rail stays visible; and the authored space-context-sidebar presents the selected Space's name, one New chat action and that Space's own recent conversations. Natively verified: Open Translate -> conversation 8f4850be..., Start a new chat in this Space -> a different conversation fff9204d... in the same Space with two sidebar rows and the rail intact, then WM_DELETE_WINDOW exited in 3s. This pass also found and fixed a real-app-only defect: the sidebar commands used ConfigureAwait(false) and resumed off the UI dispatcher, so the chat factory's VerifyAccess threw (CUIA_FAILED in the UI) and the faulted action then blocked an ordinary close for the rest of that instance. Headless coverage added for both sidebar identities. Offline degraded state observed on the real surface (Local models are unavailable) with entry/rail/sidebar/composer still usable. Still open for R02: native sidebar row click (default titles collide), website-tab draft roundtrip, 5 stale SpacesDetailsRouteTests expectations, 4 UnifiedHomeContentTests failures, and the general guarantee that a faulted UI action must not block close.
next_action: Run the R01 unsaved-draft close-preparation journey (cancel/save/discard/veto) on the real UI route, then rewrite the 5 stale SpacesDetailsRouteTests expectations against the canonical SpaceBuilderPage and diagnose the 4 UnifiedHomeContentTests failures.
